tool.name: FindSimilarTerrain
tool.summary: Finds the best-matching locations in a search area for the terrain (ridges, valleys, slopes and actual relief) inside a reference polygon, searching all rotations about the vertical axis. Score = RMSE in meters of (candidate - reference) after removing the mean difference; the mean is reported as an elevation offset. A copy 100 m higher scores about zero; a valley twice as deep is penalised. Coarse screening at a larger comparison cell size is fast but can miss terrain features smaller than that cell size; the optional native-resolution refinement re-scores the shortlist at full resolution.

param.name: dem
param.dialogReference: Elevation raster in a projected coordinate system with square cells. The native cell size (for example 2 m) is shown in the tool messages when it runs; the comparison cell size cannot be finer than it.
param.pythonReference: Elevation raster in a projected coordinate system with square cells. The native cell size (for example 2 m) is shown in the tool messages when it runs; the comparison cell size cannot be finer than it.

param.name: reference_polygon
param.dialogReference: Polygon whose terrain is to be reproduced. Selected features are used if the layer has a selection (several are unioned). May be irregular and have holes. Its physical size is preserved; it is only rotated and moved.
param.pythonReference: Polygon whose terrain is to be reproduced. Selected features are used if the layer has a selection (several are unioned). May be irregular and have holes. Its physical size is preserved; it is only rotated and moved.

param.name: search_polygon
param.dialogReference: Area to search. Selected features are used if present. Every returned polygon lies entirely inside it (holes are honoured) and on valid DTM cells. Draw a polygon in a scratch feature class, or select an existing one.
param.pythonReference: Area to search. Selected features are used if present. Every returned polygon lies entirely inside it (holes are honoured) and on valid DTM cells. Draw a polygon in a scratch feature class, or select an existing one.

param.name: cell_size
param.dialogReference: Cell size used for the search, e.g. 5, 10 or 20 m on a 2 m DTM. The DTM is aggregated (area-weighted mean, NoData aware) to this size; polygon dimensions on the ground do not change. Leave blank for an automatic choice. Coarse screening can miss terrain features smaller than this cell size; keep enough cells across the narrowest part of the reference polygon (the tool warns you).
param.pythonReference: Cell size used for the search, e.g. 5, 10 or 20 m on a 2 m DTM. The DTM is aggregated (area-weighted mean, NoData aware) to this size; polygon dimensions on the ground do not change. Leave blank for an automatic choice. Coarse screening can miss terrain features smaller than this cell size; keep enough cells across the narrowest part of the reference polygon (the tool warns you).

param.name: refine_native
param.displayname: Refine best matches at native resolution
param.dialogReference: When checked (default) a shortlist larger than the number of results is re-optimised and re-scored at the DTM's native cell size, and the final ranking and RMSE use that resolution. Search and final scoring resolutions are reported.
param.pythonReference: When checked (default) a shortlist larger than the number of results is re-optimised and re-scored at the DTM's native cell size, and the final ranking and RMSE use that resolution. Search and final scoring resolutions are reported.

param.name: out_fc
param.dialogReference: Ranked polygons: Rank, RMSE_m (terrain RMSE, meters), Offset_m (mean of candidate minus reference), Angle_deg (counter-clockwise from above, 0-360, rotation about the reference centroid), Cell_m (final scoring cell size), SearchCell_m, CoarseRMSE_m.
param.pythonReference: Ranked polygons: Rank, RMSE_m (terrain RMSE, meters), Offset_m (mean of candidate minus reference), Angle_deg (counter-clockwise from above, 0-360, rotation about the reference centroid), Cell_m (final scoring cell size), SearchCell_m, CoarseRMSE_m.

param.name: n_results
param.dialogReference: Number of distinct sites to return. Default 5.
param.pythonReference: Number of distinct sites to return. Default 5.

param.name: rotate
param.dialogReference: Default on. Terrain and polygon are rotated together about a fixed anchor; scale and handedness are preserved. Angles are found by a coarse angular scan then refined continuously (angle step tied to the footprint size).
param.pythonReference: Default on. Terrain and polygon are rotated together about a fixed anchor; scale and handedness are preserved. Angles are found by a coarse angular scan then refined continuously (angle step tied to the footprint size).

param.name: coarse_step
param.dialogReference: Automatic: about 1.5 comparison cells of movement at the outer edge of the reference polygon (1 to 20 degrees).
param.pythonReference: Automatic: about 1.5 comparison cells of movement at the outer edge of the reference polygon (1 to 20 degrees).

param.name: exhaustive
param.dialogReference: Evaluates every grid placement at every angle of the exhaustive increment (no coarse pruning). The scores are exact for that grid and increment only; the final poses are then refined continuously. Slow on large areas.
param.pythonReference: Evaluates every grid placement at every angle of the exhaustive increment (no coarse pruning). The scores are exact for that grid and increment only; the final poses are then refined continuously. Slow on large areas.

param.name: exhaustive_step
param.dialogReference: Angular increment for exhaustive mode. Automatic: half a comparison cell at the outer edge (0.25 to 5 degrees).
param.pythonReference: Angular increment for exhaustive mode. Automatic: half a comparison cell at the outer edge (0.25 to 5 degrees).

param.name: max_overlap
param.dialogReference: Results overlapping a better one by more than this fraction of the footprint are suppressed as duplicates. Default 20.
param.pythonReference: Results overlapping a better one by more than this fraction of the footprint are suppressed as duplicates. Default 20.

param.name: shortlist
param.dialogReference: Distinct seeds carried into refinement. Automatic: max(20, 4 x results).
param.pythonReference: Distinct seeds carried into refinement. Automatic: max(20, 4 x results).

param.name: out_residual
param.dialogReference: Native-resolution raster inside the best match: candidate - reference - offset (meters). Positive = the matched site is higher than the reference.
param.pythonReference: Native-resolution raster inside the best match: candidate - reference - offset (meters). Positive = the matched site is higher than the reference.

param.name: pyramid
param.dialogReference: On by default. The whole search area is scanned only at a very coarse resolution (reference about 5 cells in radius, few angles); each shortlisted candidate is then re-scored in a small window at each finer level, ending at the comparison cell size. Typically 10-50 times faster for large areas. Very small features of the reference may be missed at the coarsest level; turn off to scan every placement at the comparison cell size.
